To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
whole-blood cultures are a useful tool for the study of lymphocyte responses in humans.
the Luminetics system is a useful and rapid method for the assessment of T-lymphocytes activation in whole-blood samples.
the Luminetics ATP assay and the newly synthesized DNA assay can be used to measure T-lymphocytes in whole blood.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a simple, rapid, and safe method for measuring the activation of T-lymphocytes in whole-blood culture systems using ATP as an indicator of cell growth.
developing a simple and reliable method of determining the proliferative response of T-lymphocytes.
developing a rapid, sensitive, and reproducible assay for the measurement of T-lymphocytes responses to mitogens or recall antigens in whole blood cultures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
both the Luminetics and the ATP assays are useful in the analysis of lymphocyte activation responses.
the Luminetics system is useful for rapid (24 h), quantitative analysis of lymphocyte subsets in small amounts of whole blood.
the ATP assay is a rapid (24 h), sensitive, and reliable assay for measuring the proliferative responses of T lymphocytes to mitogenic and specific antigens.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the measurement of ATP in the Luminetics T-lymphocytes activation assay is a rapid and convenient method for the analysis of T-lymphocytic activation.
the ATP method is more rapid and easier to use than the [3H]T method.
the Luminetics system is an effective tool for the measurement of T-lymphocytes activation in whole-blood culture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Luminetics system is a useful and reliable method for the rapid assessment of T-lymphocytes responses in whole-blood cultures.
the Luminetics T-cell activation assay is a useful tool for measuring T-cell activation responses.
the ATP assay is a rapid and reliable method of measuring T-lymphocytes responses to mitogens, and the Luminetics method is a useful tool for assessing T-lym- phocyte subsets responses.
